name: Branch
description: Branch is a mobile linking and measurement platform for deep links, deferred routing, attribution, campaign analytics, journeys, ads, and data feeds. Product and growth teams use it to route users across web and apps while measuring acquisition and engagement.
agentUseSummary: Add a Branch Key and bind one exact HTTPS Branch link; agents can verify only its redacted structural lifecycle metadata through one fixed read endpoint.

credentialRequirements.name: BRANCH_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Branch Key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the exact live or test Branch Key for the originating app. Relay encrypts the connection value even though Branch documents this key as public.

credentialRequirements.name: BRANCH_LINK_URL
credentialRequirements.label: Bound Branch link URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind one exact HTTPS Branch link at connection time; agents cannot replace it at runtime.

capabilities.label: Inspect bound link structure
capabilities.description: Verify one exact link and return only lifecycle and field-presence metadata with values excluded.

approvalRequired.label: Inspect bound Branch link structure
approvalRequired.description: Verify one exact bound link and return only one-time-use, creation-source, match-duration, tag-count, and field-presence metadata.

blocked.label: Access link content or destinations
blocked.description: The Branch link URL, aliases, destinations, routes, Open Graph content, custom data, tags, channel/feature/campaign/stage values, and link IDs remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access identity, attribution, or device data
blocked.description: Identities, sessions, clicks, installs, events, campaigns, ads, users, devices, advertising IDs, IPs, locations, revenue, cost, fraud, and analytics remain blocked.

blocked.label: Create, update, delete, or administer Branch
blocked.description: Link generation, updates, deletion, bulk links, apps, credentials, domains, integrations, callbacks, webhooks, journeys, ads, exports, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Branch Secret and Access Token use, arbitrary apps, links, origins, paths, methods, headers, queries, bodies, analytics, pagination, polling, retries, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and exports remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bound-link read requires approval because Branch reads may extend link expiration; content, identity, attribution, analytics, writes, raw APIs, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bound-link read runs directly; exact binding, redaction, caps, audits, provider authority, and rate limits remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one exact connection-bound redacted Branch link reader.
Hermes receives the same exact connection-bound redacted Branch link reader.

providerSetup.blocker: Branch access requires an eligible customer app, its exact live or test Branch Key, one existing HTTPS Branch link, and live read acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer admin supplies the exact Branch Key and link, then completes a live approval-controlled read acceptance check.

evidence.supports: Branch documents GET /url using an originating-app Branch Key and exact deep-link URL, returning channel, feature, campaign, stage, tags, routing content, IDs, lifecycle fields, and 400/429 responses.
Branch documents the api2.branch.io Deep Linking API, read/create/update/delete and bulk capabilities, and GET rate limits of 100/second, 5,500/minute, and 100,000/hour.
Branch documents Branch Key as public, Branch Secret as private server-side authentication, and Access Token as permission-bearing organization authority.
Branch documents deep-link behavior and that API reads reset the link-expiration window, so Relay approval-gates the read in Safe mode.

securityNotes: Relay encrypts the connection-bound public Branch Key and exact HTTPS link and never exposes either to agents or results.
Relay allowlists only GET https://api2.branch.io/v1/url with connection-bound branch_key and url query values, rejects redirects, waits 30 seconds, and caps responses at 1 MB.

Output contains only structural booleans and bounded counts; URLs, destinations, aliases, link IDs, identities, tags, channel/feature/campaign/stage values, custom data, attribution, and device data are excluded.
Safe mode requires approval because Branch documents that reading a link can extend its expiration window; Dangerous mode removes only Relay approval.
Create/update/delete, bulk links, analytics, exports, apps, credentials, integrations, arbitrary endpoints/inputs, pagination, polling, retries, SDKs, and browser sessions remain blocked.
Provider setup, credential capture, link selection, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
